pipeline_stages.description: Ingestion of NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375m (VNP14IMGTDL_NRT & VJ114IMGTDL_NRT) active fire detection streams. Removes non-vegetative thermal anomalies, corrects bow-tie pixel distortion along satellite scan corridors, and flags low-confidence detections.
pipeline_stages.output: Cleaned spatio-temporal active fire observations with calibrated Fire Radiative Power (MW).

pipeline_stages.description: Rigorous verification of 5 formal physical hypotheses governing wildfire mechanics, distinguishing correlational artifacts from causal drivers across biome classes, diurnal solar radiation cycles, and meteorological extremes.

parameters.Hypotheses Evaluated: H1 (Diurnal Ratio), H2 (FRP Lognormal), H3 (Boreal Night Burning), H4 (VPD Escalation), H5 (Wind Directional Spread)

pipeline_stages.output: Statistical validation matrices and non-parametric divergence profiles across global biomes.

pipeline_stages.description: Comparative evaluation of Simple Random Sampling (SRS), Stratified Sampling (by Biome & FRP Quintile), Spatial Grid-Cell Sampling, and Temporal Window Sampling across 1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, and 50% fractions.
pipeline_stages.output: Optimal 10% stratified sample achieving <0.024 KS divergence with 90% memory reduction.

pipeline_stages.description: Deployment of fundamental MMD techniques: PageRank on spatial fire propagation networks, DGIM sliding-window bit counting for real-time anomaly detection, FP-Growth for multi-variable environmental co-occurrence mining, and PCY hash-filtered candidate pair discovery.
pipeline_stages.output: Spatiotemporal propagation hubs, sub-millisecond streaming anomaly counters, and frequent condition itemsets.

pipeline_stages.description: Ensemble Random Forest classifier trained on spatio-temporal, meteorological, and historical ignition features. Strictly framed as statistical Fire-Activity Risk probability rather than guaranteed fire predictions, calibrated via isotonic/Platt scaling.
pipeline_stages.output: Calibrated probabilistic fire-activity index categorized into Low, Moderate, High, and Extreme risk tiers.

pipeline_stages.description: Decoupled analytical pipeline executing complex Python MMD algorithms offline into precomputed, immutable JSON data stores. Next.js 14 App Router statically renders views on Vercel's global edge network with sub-50ms TTFB.
pipeline_stages.output: Blazing-fast, production-grade technical dashboard accessible worldwide with zero server compute overhead.
